description_full:
📢 WE ARE HIRING!

S&P Law Office is currently opening an opportunity for a Legal Internship.

Bagi kamu mahasiswa tingkat akhir atau fresh graduate jurusan Hukum yang ingin mengembangkan pengalaman dan kemampuan di bidang hukum, yuk bergabung bersama tim kami!

📩 Send your CV and recent photo to:
splaw.careers@gmail.com
Subject: Legalintern_Name

🗓️ Open until November 30th, 2026.

Don't miss this opportunity! ⚖️
